resources.name: FeSi crystal structure (B20, space group P2₁3)

access.notes: Public crystallographic data. Experimental lattice constant a=4.489 Å, internal coordinates u_Fe=0.137, u_Si=0.842 from Villars and Calvert (1985). These will be stated in the instruction as the starting point for geometry optimization.

resources.name: Diffuse basis set exponents for Fe and Si

access.notes: Diffuse exponents for the Gaussian basis set (Table 1 of the source paper). The instruction will provide these numbers directly. Alternatively, the agent may select pseudopotentials or basis sets of comparable quality from standard libraries.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code with hybrid functional support

access.notes: Any all-electron or pseudopotential DFT package that implements PW91 GGA, B3LYP hybrid functional, and Hartree-Fock. Examples: Quantum ESPRESSO (with exact exchange), CP2K (GAPW), FHI-aims. The instruction suggests using one of these.
Optional; only needed if the chosen code uses pseudopotentials instead of all-electron basis.
